sessions.phase_label: TPEC proposal planning and preliminary scope
GreenLatinos RFQ scoping and design kickoff
Content handoff and initial proposal production
Draft review, revisions, and final delivery

requirements.title: TPEC Submission Compliance
requirements.definition: Prepare the prospective TPEC proposal to comply with the eventual RFP's page, file-size, formatting, and submission constraints.
requirements.boundary_note: Compliance constraints are independently testable against the RFP and remain separate from the proposal's visual design.

requirements.title: TPEC Proposal Design
requirements.definition: Provide layout, branding, resume treatment, and related graphic design for the TPEC proposal.
requirements.boundary_note: Template reuse and possible omission of maps or infographics are scope parameters of this planned design engagement, not separate mechanisms.

requirements.title: TPEC Source Files and PDF Delivery
requirements.definition: Deliver both the final TPEC proposal PDF and the original editable design files.
requirements.boundary_note: The PDF and original files form one explicitly requested final-deliverable package for the TPEC proposal.

requirements.title: RFQ Document Layout and Graphic Treatment
requirements.definition: Create a clean, cohesive, and navigable layout and graphic treatment for the complete GreenLatinos RFQ response.
requirements.boundary_note: This covers the overall layout system; brand identity, imagery, typography, structured content, and output-file behavior are independently changeable and remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Agua Arc Brand Application
requirements.definition: Design the RFQ response around Agua Arc's logo, colors, fonts, and company identity rather than GreenLatinos branding.
requirements.boundary_note: Brand identity can be changed without altering the underlying document layout or content, so it is independent of general proposal design.

requirements.title: Proposal Photo Selection and Treatment
requirements.definition: Integrate the requested proposal photos and apply client-directed selection, replacement, placement, and cropping treatments.
requirements.boundary_note: Individual photo choices and crops are attributes and revisions of one imagery mechanism rather than separate Requirements per page.

requirements.title: Proposal Typography Consistency
requirements.definition: Use consistent font families and appropriate font sizes across corresponding proposal sections.
requirements.boundary_note: Typography consistency has its own acceptance criterion and can fail independently of imagery, branding, or general layout.

requirements.title: Fixed RFQ Section Order
requirements.definition: Preserve the section order mandated by the client's RFQ question-and-answer guidance.
requirements.boundary_note: Required ordering is an independently testable structural constraint and is not merely an aesthetic layout preference.

requirements.title: Proposal Table Integration
requirements.definition: Format and integrate the proposal's budget, payment, milestone, and other supplied tables, including later replacements and row additions.
requirements.boundary_note: The individual tables and row counts are changing inputs to one table-integration behavior; photo, bio, and narrative integration remain separate.

requirements.title: Organization Chart Integration
requirements.definition: Integrate the organization chart into the formatted RFQ response.
requirements.boundary_note: The organization chart is a distinct structured artifact that could be added or revised independently of tables, biographies, and photographs.

requirements.title: Team Biography Integration
requirements.definition: Provide appendix placement for the additional Message Agency team biographies, initially through placeholders and later through supplied completed bios.
requirements.boundary_note: The four bios are content instances within one appendix-bio behavior rather than four separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Section 2 Subsection Inclusion
requirements.definition: Add the Section 2 subsection that was missing from the original master document into the proposal.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a specific content-completeness obligation and is separate from preserving section order or styling the document.

requirements.title: One-Page Cover Letter
requirements.definition: Format the proposal letter as a single page with room for the client's signature and relocate favored images if they no longer fit.
requirements.boundary_note: The cover letter has its own page-count and signature acceptance criteria and can be revised independently of the rest of the proposal.

requirements.title: RFQ Page-Limit Compliance
requirements.definition: Fit the formatted RFQ response within the applicable proposal page limit, initially anticipated to be approximately 20 pages.
requirements.boundary_note: Page-count compliance is independently testable from visual quality; the precise enforceable cap is not fully stated in the messages.

requirements.title: Editable Canva Source Access
requirements.definition: Provide the client with an owned, editable Canva design using free assets so the proposal can be edited, reused, and adapted without a paid Canva subscription.
requirements.boundary_note: Editable ownership of the current design is distinct from building a purpose-designed modular template system for varying future proposals.

requirements.title: Final Email-Compatible PDF Export
requirements.definition: Deliver the complete proposal as one clean, print-ready PDF optimized and compressed for email distribution.
requirements.boundary_note: Single-file format, print readiness, and email-compatible size are coupled output parameters of the final PDF export; hyperlink behavior is verified separately.

requirements.title: PDF Hyperlink Functionality
requirements.definition: Preserve functional hyperlinks when the proposal is exported and delivered as the final PDF.
requirements.boundary_note: Hyperlinks have a separate executed acceptance test and can fail even when PDF export and file size are otherwise correct.

requirements.title: Consolidated Revision Round
requirements.definition: Provide one consolidated freelancer revision pass after the client's review of the initial proposal draft.
requirements.boundary_note: The promised revision opportunity is an independently contracted delivery obligation, not generic QA or debugging activity.

requirements.title: RFQ Draft and Final Delivery Schedule
requirements.definition: Deliver the initial draft and final revisions within the compressed schedule needed for submission by the GreenLatinos deadline.
requirements.boundary_note: This captures the independently changing turnaround obligation; routine availability and contract administration are excluded.

requirements.title: Modular Reusable Proposal Template
requirements.definition: Build a reusable Agua Arc proposal template with flexible narrative sections, resizable table styles, and swappable client-identification fields.
requirements.boundary_note: This purpose-built modular system is independently scoped and was deferred; ordinary editability and reuse of the current Canva file remain under the source-access Requirement.
